method: Campground-specific points were matched to current operator maps and pages. Washington State Parks general locate points were replaced with named campground areas where the campground is distinct. Seattle route baselines use OSRM from central Seattle; public estimates round upward for towing, traffic, and local-road variation. Hozomeen's computed route is retained only as an audit baseline because current NPS closures prohibit completing the trip by vehicle.

reviews.address: Silver Skagit Road, Ross Lake National Recreation Area, WA (usual road approach is through Hope, BC)
reviews.coordinate_source: Named Hozomeen Campground point corroborated by the NPS Hozomeen area description and Hozomeen Camp SNOTEL location
reviews.route_note: Routing baseline follows the usual Canada approach. It is not a currently drivable itinerary: the NPS says the Hozomeen border gate is closed, cross-border vehicle and foot traffic are prohibited, and the entire Hozomeen area is currently closed for the Border 2 Fire.

reviews.address: North Lake Cushman Road / Forest Road 24, Hoodsport, WA 98548
reviews.coordinate_source: USGS GNIS named Big Creek Campground point corroborated by Olympic National Forest facility locations and directions
reviews.route_note: No-ferry I-5, US 101, WA 119, and North Lake Cushman Road route. Public estimate adds a towing, traffic, and forest-road margin.

reviews.route_note: Fastest normal I-5, US 101, WA 8, US 12, and WA 105 route at review time; public estimate rounds up for towing and traffic variation.
